gizmo.title: Aagga dhigista sawirka
gizmo.description: Ardaydu waxay calaamado dul dhigaan aagag ku dul yaal sawir, kadibna waxay hubiyaan jawaabtooda.

configure.title: Qoraal beddel ah
configure.description: Wuxuu u sharxaa sawirka dadka aan arki karin. Ha muujin meesha calaamaduhu galayaan.

configure.title: Cinwaanka sawirka
configure.description: Cinwaan gaaban oo muuqda oo sawirka ah, oo ka muuqda korkiisa.

configure.title: Su'aal
configure.description: Waxa ardayda laga codsanayo inay ku sameeyaan calaamadaha.

configure.title: Calaamadaha iyo aagagga
configure.description: Shay kastaa waa calaamad ay ardaydu dhigi karaan. Calaamad sii magac aag si aad aaggeeda u dhigto sawirka; calaamad aan magac aag lahayn waa dheeraad aan meelna ka tirsanayn. Tirooyinka aagga waa boqolleyda sawirka.

configure.title: Qoraal sharraxaad
configure.description: Qoraal sharraxaad ikhtiyaari ah oo ka muuqda sawirka hoostiisa.

advanced.title: Isku dayada
advanced.description: Immisa jeer ayuu ardaygu hubin karaa. 0 macnaheedu waa xad la'aan.

advanced.title: Isku qas calaamadaha
advanced.description: Muuji calaamadaha habab kala duwan booqasho kasta.

advanced.title: La isku duubi karo
advanced.description: U muuji su'aashan sida saf la furo oo la xiro. Furitaanka mid wuxuu xiraa su'aalaha kale ee la isku duubi karo ee agtiisa ah.

advanced.title: Ku bilow isagoo duuban
advanced.description: Marka la isku duubi karo, ku bilow saf xiran oo muujiya su'aasha iyo xaaladdeeda oo keliya.

advanced.title: Qaabka qiimaynta
advanced.description: OER Schema: qaabka qiimaynta ee qiimayntan (tusaale dhibco, xaraf, boqolley, dhammaystir).

advanced.title: Ujeeddada waxbarasho
advanced.description: OER Schema: ujeeddada waxbarasho ee la xiriirta qiimayntan.

developer.title: Magaca kedisada
developer.description: Magaca kedisada loo isticmaalo aqoonsiga xAPI ee nidaamyada falanqaynta.

developer.title: Koorso
developer.description: OER Schema: koorsada qiimayntan loogu talagalay.
